about: Nano demand register. 'requests' = a party OUTSIDE this project saying in its own words that it wants to pay (or be paid) in XNO at a named seller. 'gates' = sellers that told us demand is what they wait for. A request counts only if its quote appears verbatim in the public conversation file. Nothing is seeded: an empty requests list prints 0.

gates.quote: we add a new payment rail when we see real, paying demand on it
gates.stated_proof: once we receive actual USDC-settled x402 calls that are funded via a Nano-to-USDC bridge, we'll open the rail
gates.stated_proof_quote: In practice that means: once we receive actual USDC-settled x402 calls that are funded via a Nano-to-USDC bridge, we'll open the rail
gates.ask_again_when: 3 distinct outside requesters for this host in requests[], or one verified Nano-funded USDC call on its catalogue
gates.note: Its faucet is free and takes no payment, so a Nano holder can use it today without any Nano rail: listed as a no-XNO, free-to-use host, not as an XNO seller.
